facts.text: Nine Orchard occupies the restored former Jarmulowsky Bank building.
facts.excerpt: meticulously restored and reimagined the century-old Jarmulowsky Bank into an elegant hotel and culinary destination

facts.text: The former Jarmulowsky Bank building was originally built in 1912.
facts.excerpt: Originally built in 1912, the former Jarmulowsky Bank has been lovingly restored for travelers and locals alike.

facts.text: The hotel is in the Lower East Side of downtown New York.
facts.excerpt: Housed in an iconic Lower East Side landmark

facts.text: The rooms keep original Neo-Renaissance details.
facts.excerpt: Alive with original, Neo-Renaissance details and novel craftsmanship, our rooms offer guests a home-away-from-home

facts.text: Guest rooms feature original moldings and large windows that bring in natural light.
facts.excerpt: from original moldings and distinctive artisanship to large windows that fill the space with natural light

facts.text: Rooms display commissioned artworks by local artists.
facts.excerpt: complemented by a collection of commissioned artworks from local artists and one-of-a-kind accents and furniture

facts.text: Rooms have custom-made Ojas speakers programmed with New York-inspired stations curated by Devon Turnbull and DJ Stretch Armstrong.
facts.excerpt: custom-made Ojas speakers and amplifiers are programmed with four New York-inspired stations curated by Devon Turnbull and DJ Stretch Armstrong for our guests

facts.text: The first floor has Corner Bar, an all-day restaurant inspired by classic taverns, and Swan Room, a living room by day and cocktail lounge by night.
facts.excerpt: The first floor features two distinct culinary experiences: Corner Bar, our comfortable all-day restaurant inspired by classic taverns; and Swan Room, a grand living room-by-day and lavish cocktail lounge by night.

facts.text: The Swan Room is set in the former bank teller room, with a vaulted ceiling and pink Tennessee marble walls.
facts.excerpt: Found in the former bank teller room — with its vaulted ceiling, luxurious booths, and pink Tennessee marble walls

facts.text: The Terrace Suite has a private terrace and city skyline views.
facts.excerpt: including a private 200 square foot terrace, sleeps two in a King bed and features a sitting area and sweeping city skyline views

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Terrace Suite has a private terrace with lounge chairs and a dining table.
facts.excerpt: private terrace that features lounge chairs and a dining table

facts.text: The Design Suite has sweeping Manhattan skyline views and an enhanced minibar with a Subzero fridge.
facts.excerpt: boasts sweeping views of the Manhattan skyline, has two televisions with Apple TV, and an enhanced minibar with Subzero fridge

facts.text: The Corner King has curved corner windows.
facts.excerpt: features an antique custom desk, walk-in shower or tub, and curved corner windows

facts.text: The hotel has three event spaces.
facts.excerpt: three event spaces are designed for gatherings both small and large

facts.text: Rooms are labeled like New York apartments, such as 2A or 4F, as an homage to city apartment living.
facts.excerpt: labeled as an homage to NYC apartment living

facts.text: The hotel is on the corner of Orchard and Canal Street.
facts.excerpt: Located on the corner of Orchard and Canal Street, the playground of the Lower East Side is at your fingertips.

facts.text: The A, C and F trains are a one-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: with the A, C, and F trains a one-minute walk from the hotel

facts.text: The original vaulted bank ceiling is the centerpiece of the cocktail lounge.
facts.excerpt: with the main star being the original vaulted bank ceiling of the hotel

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler advises reserving ahead for the Swan Room.
facts.excerpt: Be sure to make a reservation in advance to enjoy the lobby Swan Room.

facts.text: Light sleepers may notice city street noise.
facts.excerpt: A desirable city location can oftentimes come with undesirable city noises.

facts.text: The overall vibe is chic, cool and largely for adults.
facts.excerpt: chic, cool, and largely for adults

facts.text: Nine Orchard was on Conde Nast Traveler's Hot List 2023.
facts.excerpt: Hot List 2023

facts.text: Service is relaxed and attentive.
facts.excerpt: relaxed and attentive
